## Summary
Appreciation post for the Chinese open-source community's research sharing; the author found a repository with **over 5,000 trading strategies, indicators, and code snippets**, all shared openly. Repo: **https://github.com/fmzquant/strategies** (FMZ Quant — Chinese algo-trading platform's community strategy library). "The amount of alpha collected there and then made freely available to everyone is crazy."

## Why it matters
- Huge free corpus of *implemented* strategies — a natural mine for the 2026-08-29/30 systematic-trading cluster: search for RSI(2)-style dip buys, MA+ATR breakouts, and IBS variants; CN-community libraries also carry grid/Martingale and native-CN patterns worth skimming.
- FMZ platform heritage means many entries are JS/Python aimed at crypto exchanges — check instrument/market assumptions before trusting any rule.
- Third node of the 08-30 systematic-trading cluster and the evening burst's "open knowledge" outlier alongside the agent-skills theme.
